# Set-ZbxTemplate

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a template.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxTemplate [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Uuid <string>] [-DisplayName <string>] [-Description <string>] [-VendorName <string>] [-VendorVersion <string>] [-Group <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateGroup>[]>] [-LinkedTemplate <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]>] [-TemplatesClear <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]>] [-Tag <ZabbixTagRequest[]>] [-Macro <ZabbixTemplateUpdateMacroRequest[]>] [-WizardReady <ZabbixTemplateWizardReady>] [-Readme <string>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A template is a reusable set of items, triggers, graphs, discovery rules and dashboards; linking it to a host gives the host all of them. The Set-ZbxTemplate cmdlet changes the templates given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with template.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every template the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed templates back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Describe a template

```powershell
Set-ZbxTemplate -InputObject 'Web App' -Description 'Monitors the web application tier' -PassThru | Select-Object HostName, Description
```

-InputObject (position 0) takes the template's name, id or object.

### Example 2: Set a template's macros

```powershell
Set-ZbxTemplate -InputObject 'Web App' -Macro @{ macro = '{$APP.PORT}'; value = '8080' }, @{ macro = '{$APP.TIMEOUT}'; value = '5s' }
```

-Macro replaces the template's macros; a host linked to the template inherits them unless it sets its own.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue), -LinkedTemplate (ByPropertyName), -TemplatesClear (ByPropertyName). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Uuid (ByPropertyName), -Name (ByPropertyName), -DisplayName (ByPropertyName), -Description (ByPropertyName), -VendorName (ByPropertyName), -VendorVersion (ByPropertyName), -Readme (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateGroup>[]`: Bound to -Group (ByPropertyName). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `ZabbixTagRequest[]`: Bound to -Tag (ByPropertyName). A tag to set on an object: a name with an optional value, such as env=prod.
- `ZabbixTemplateUpdateMacroRequest[]`: Bound to -Macro (ByPropertyName). macros of a ZabbixTemplateUpdateRequest.
- `ZabbixTemplateWizardReady`: Bound to -WizardReady (ByPropertyName). The template wizard ready values: ZBX_WIZARD_* in defines.inc.php.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.
